Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in League City for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Tree Lighting Ceremony and Jingle on the Boardwalk at Kemah Boardwalk) through December 20, with Holiday in the Park (December 4 to 6), Nutcracker in the Park, Breakfast with Santa and Christmas in the Park in Webster (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in League City

  • Parades and tree lightings: Tree Lighting Ceremony (November 28), Grand Night Parade (December 5)
